column1: # Rule: a rule's literal target names are a function (one per name in a multi
# target rule); `define NAME` is a function; a variable assigned with =, :=,
# ::=, ?= or != (also after export/override and inside a conditional) is a
# variable. Not definitions: += (it appends to a variable defined elsewhere),
# prerequisites, pattern rules (%), suffix rules and special targets (a name
# starting with a dot, .PHONY), make's own settings (SHELL, MAKEFLAGS, VPATH,
# .DEFAULT_GOAL), targets spelled with a variable reference, includes, vpath.
# Narrow because a target or variable is what a developer runs or greps for;
# Makefile.stm32 and Makefile.mimxrt: a substitution reference with an empty replacement ($(BOARD_DIR:/=)) in the middle of a file; every rule and assignment after it is still read.
